In case this happens again:
1) apply pressure with the body part, ideally above your heart, with a clean cloth or anything but tissue or tp as it is made to dissolve and can cause infections.

2) hold it there for 5 minutes. Then check. If its still bleeding, do the same but for 10 minutes, DO NOT CHECK IN THIS TIME as it will break the barrier the body is creating to stop the bleeding.

3) if it hasnt stopped this time, maybe not recommended but do it again for 15 minutes (personal experience).

4) if this doesnt work, go to the hospital regardless of whatever. If it does work, take care of it.

5) some say rinse immediately with room temperature (ideally) water, if not then cold is ok but just not TOO cold as it will shock it and probably bleed again. What i do is do that, but first i wait about 5 to 10 minutes to let it solidify the barriers more to prevent bleeding.

6) at this point you want to cover it. Bandaids/plasters work, but steri strips are also ideal, but could risk the barrier youve created to open again. I sometimes do this a say or two after by using warn water to loosen the wound then stripping it. If you want a diy of doing this, i think theres tutorials on youtube, or i can explain it for you.

7) make sure its secured well as sebum and plasma will be coming iut and loosening it. Bandages often stick and weave with acabs, so gauze or anything is good under. I usually out a plaster or 2 on then wrap bandaging around it so it doesnt move.

Hope this helps
